title: FoAutoCollect
description: Automatic player-owned item and XP collection with safe FoDrops support.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66be93b51269d9274678653a1a9a4614666230da.png)
**Send player-owned drops and XP straight to inventories without messy ground clutter or unsafe reward guessing.**

FoAutoCollect gives players a simple toggle for automatic collection while giving server owners precise control over where and how it works. It supports vanilla block, mob, fishing, shearing, and player-sourced explosion rewards, with a direct FoDrops hook for custom rewards when FoDrops is installed.

![FoAutoCollect editor main menu with collection categories](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59a639f0c6f824b2a43ae1a6d678b801231f3e5a.png)

## Features

- Let players toggle auto collect with `/foautocollect`, `/autocollect`, or explicit `on`, `off`, and `status` states.
- Collect drops and experience from block breaks, mob kills, fishing, shearing, and supported explosions.
- Integrate with FoDrops through `FoDropRewardEvent` so custom rewards are collected directly and safely.
- Configure enabled worlds, disabled worlds, disabled blocks, and disabled mobs per collection category.
- Choose how full inventories behave: drop overflow at the source or block collection entirely.
- Force auto collect on for everyone when the server needs a global collection mode.

![Category editor showing world, drop, XP, and blacklist controls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47900d382b98e56cfc3d9221eb1162a70bd969d1.png)

![Full inventory behavior warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33ab50a8b9fdb37038a0bc88f795bcbc0f73f4b9.png)

## Dependencies

- **Optional:** FoDrops for direct custom reward collection.
- **Optional:** FoDropBoosters for multiplying certain drops.
- **Optional:** FoConvertors for converting certain amount of items into something else.
- **Optional:** PlaceholderAPI for placeholder support.

## Commands

- `/foautocollect` - Toggle your current auto collect state.
- `/foautocollect status` - Check whether auto collect is enabled.
- `/foautocollect on` - Enable auto collect.
- `/foautocollect off` - Disable auto collect.
- `/foautocollectadmin version` - Show plugin info and check Modrinth for updates.
- `/foautocollectadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, and cached settings.
- `/foautocollectadmin editor` - Open the GUI editor.
- `/foautocollectadmin set <player> <on|off>` - Set an online player's session state.
- `/foautocollectadmin force <on|off|status>` - Control forced auto collect.

## Permissions

- `foautocollect.use` - Use the player toggle command.
- `foautocollect.admin` - Access admin commands and the editor.

## Placeholders
- `%foautocollect_state%` - Returns enabled or disabled for the player's current auto collect state.
